title: $100 a month into Adobe since 2000 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Adobe since 2000.
Today that would be worth about {dca:ADBE:2000-01-03} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Adobe price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Adobe, starting in 2000.
Back then, Adobe was making Photoshop.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:ADBE:2000-01-03}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
